source: NASA POWER Zarr archive (AWS Open Data)

variable.definition: The total atmospheric water vapor contained in a vertical column of unit cross-sectional area extending from the surface to the top of the atmosphere, sourced from the GMAO.

outline.source: IPCC AR6 WGI land reference regions (v4)

processing: selected grid cells whose centres fall inside the region outline (straight edges in lon/lat; cells on a left/bottom edge in, right/top edge out)
kept land cells only (MERRA-2 cells with root-zone soil wetness; nearest MERRA-2 cell for other grids); ocean, lakes and ice sheets excluded
area mean with cos(latitude) weights, ignoring missing cells
dropped time steps with no data (the store pre-allocates future dates)
